description: Source code implementing signal processing for haptic effects, including filter calculations, envelope processing, and distortion, within the android::audio_effect::haptic_generator namespace.

classes.name: Ramp
classes.description: Class for processing ramp signals, including optional NEON-accelerated processing.

classes.name: SlowEnvelope
classes.description: Class for computing a slow envelope of a signal using a low-pass filter.

classes.name: Distortion
classes.description: Class for applying nonlinear distortion effects with configurable parameters.

methods.name: getRealPoleZ
methods.description: Calculates the real pole of a first order filter based on corner frequency and sample rate.

methods.name: getComplexPoleZ
methods.description: Calculates the complex conjugate poles for a bandpass filter based on ringing frequency, Q factor, and sample rate.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Method for processing signal data in Ramp, SlowEnvelope, and Distortion classes.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears internal state in Ramp, SlowEnvelope, and Distortion classes.

methods.name: setCornerFrequency
methods.description: Sets corner frequency and updates filter coefficients in Distortion.

methods.name: setInputGain
methods.description: Sets input gain parameter in Distortion.

methods.name: setCubeThrehold
methods.description: Sets cube threshold parameter in Distortion.

methods.name: setOutputGain
methods.description: Sets output gain parameter in Distortion.
